ms.report:
This milestone delivers the final deliverable for the Cardano Funding Ecosystem Assessment. The document provides adoption guidance for each framework component (Coordination Infrastructure, Builder Profiles, Impact Measurement, Unified Project Tracking), documents the knowledge transfer process through the Intersect Ecosystem Funding Working Group, and closes out the project with findings, recommendations, deliverables, and lessons learned.
All materials are published open-source under MIT license.
